Header: Stenchaetothrips biformis Bagnall. เพลี้ยไฟข้าว

Prevention: Cultural control : flooding to submerge the infected rice field for 2 days is effective in reducing thrips populations
Rice field sanitation, remove weeds to reduce host plant.
Monitoring: Regular visit rice field every two weeks after sowing rice about 7 days.
Inspect the leaves for damage such as leaf curl, silvery streaks, yellow patches, and feeding streaks.
Direct Control: Flooding to submerge the infected rice field for 2 days.
Restrictions: Apply insecticide such as carbaryl (Commercial name:
When leaf curl has been found in about 50% of the rice field 2 weeks after sowing
